mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.25 percentage points triggers negative equity returns as market participants anticipate reduced corporate profitability and lower risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals labor market tightening that reduces corporate labor costs, expanding profit margins and driving positive equity returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease) occurs in more than 60% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP growth regime (GDPC1 annualized growth rate > 4.0%), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive equity returns as corporate sales expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises and GDPC1 growth rate > 4.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained housing starts level above 1400 thousand units signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1 percentage points triggers positive equity returns as reduced labor market slack boosts consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
evidence_refs: fact:May 2023 UNRATE was 3.7% (down from 3.8% in April)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in inflation signals stagflationary pressures, compressing profit margins and driving negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls and CPIAUCSL rises in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO fall and CPIAUCSL rise) occurs in more than 60% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 102.5), rising industrial production signals robust output growth, leading to positive equity returns as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5.
